N005.ligature_policy: Correct multi-character ToUnicode ff/fi/fl/ffi outputs stay unchanged; no glyph-name substitution forces a one-codepoint ligature.
N005.phi_policy: The two actual phi outlines and their existing Unicode variants were inspected and retained; AGL naming alone does not override the printed form.
N005.XY_policy: Actual XYDASH and XYATIP/XYBTIP dictionaries and bytes have individual outlines. Half-tip curvature and complete arrow assembly remain unmeasured. A directional token is a proposed proxy, not an exact Unicode glyph name.
N005.brace_policy: Extensible left-brace components use their visible Unicode pieces. Curved under/overbrace tips are separately disclosed corner proxies; their full geometric assembly is unmeasured.

inherited_N006_N007.scope: Only byte-identical source PDFs inherit accepted font-map/outline evidence; their fresh event audits and all substitutions must still equal the prior counts.

replacement_policy: All changed replacement pages freshly viewed. Type0 font dictionaries are hash-bound, with unchanged literal Unicode. The sporadic/HN Type1 math characters are freshly aligned but their PDF bytes and previous visual checks are unchanged. Zero replacement substitutions.
